summary: FOLLOW-UP verification round: confirmed the codePhraseStore.ts crash fix (try/catch around SecureStore write path) resolves the critical red-screen bug from iteration_51. Also re-ran the Scenario 8 account-isolation check and regression smoke tests for guardian-share and trusted-circle. All PASS.
action_items: No action needed for the primary bug — fix verified working.

Optional/low-priority: during fast account switches via page.goto + full reload, there can be a brief transient render of the previous screen's DOM content before the new account's data loads (observed once as a flicker of Account A's contact name appearing for ~1 frame on Account B's trusted-circle screen in one of two runs, self-resolved in under a second once AsyncStorage read completed). This is a web-preview/SPA-navigation timing artifact, not a real data-isolation leak — confirmed via two independent re-tests (immediate text-check after the flicker, and a slower re-run with extended settle waits) that B's contact list was correctly empty/isolated in both cases. No fix required unless it visually bothers reviewers; could add a loading skeleton on trusted-circle while getCircle() resolves to eliminate the flicker entirely.
critical_code_review_comments: codePhraseStore.ts storePhrase()/clearPhrase() write path now correctly wrapped in try/catch mirroring the existing read-path pattern — verified no uncaught rejection on web where expo-secure-store has no web implementation.

code-phrase.tsx Platform.OS==='web' inline notice is present and reads 'Secure on-device storage for the code phrase needs the DHARA mobile app — it cannot be saved from this web preview.' — clear and accurate.

Account isolation design (per-account-id-scoped storage keys in both codePhraseStore.ts and api.ts) is sound and was reconfirmed working for trusted-circle contacts and code-phrase armed-state across Account A -> Account B switch in the same browser session.
seed_data_creation: Added a synthetic trusted-circle contact 'RegTestContactA' / 9998887771 to Account A during testing (not cleaned up — test data, safe to leave or remove). No real code phrase text persisted beyond transient in-memory state (SecureStore has no web backend, so nothing durable was written anyway).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRIMARY BUG (codePhraseStore crash on web Save/Remove) is CONFIRMED FIXED — no red-screen, no console/pageerror events during save (fill TextInput -> tap 'Save code phrase'), ARMED badge appeared, 'Remove code phrase' also worked cleanly, OFF badge restored. Web notice text 'needs the DHARA mobile app' confirmed visible in Platform.OS==='web' branch. Scenario 8 (Account A armed -> switch to Account B same session) confirmed Account B shows 'OFF — no phrase saved yet', not inheriting A's armed state — isolation holds within a single continuous session (expected, per the note that SecureStore doesn't persist on web even same-account on reload — this is a known web-only platform limitation, not a bug, and was NOT treated as a failure). Guardian-share regression: revoke-sharing flow still shows the missed-check-in warning text pre-tap, and 'I have arrived safely' (mark-safe) button remains visible/independent after revoke — matches iteration 49/50 behavior. Trusted-circle regression: add-contact flow worked past the LanguageOnboardModal (dismissed via 'Continue in <language>' button), and account-switch isolation (A's contact not visible to B) reconfirmed with two independent checks including one with extended settle time. No further testing needed on this specific bug; safe to close.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this is a verification pass confirming a previously-reported RCA (codePhraseStore.ts write path calling SecureStore.setItemAsync/deleteItemAsync without try/catch on a platform — web — where expo-secure-store has no native module, causing an unhandled promise rejection / red screen). The fix mirrors the existing read-path's try/catch pattern and was independently verified to resolve the crash across both Save and Remove actions with zero console errors observed.
